trusted: The coordinator invokes only the exact reviewed bootstrap after exact token substitution.
Git object bytes are content-addressed and all reads set GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1.
The pinned host executables match their recorded SHA-256 values and behave according to their documented interfaces.
The local Docker daemon, host kernel, and digest-bound image report truthful inspect, exit, and cgroup state.

Receipt principal authenticity is a trusted external property supplied by the multi-agent orchestrator; the validator proves only exact syntax, exclusion, pairwise distinction, role binding, and content binding.
excluded: A malicious concurrent process under the same uid after bootstrap begins.
Intentional deletion or rewriting of the dedicated consumption ref, its reflog, Git objects, or authorization history.
Compromise of the Docker daemon, host kernel, SHA-1 or SHA-256 implementations, pinned executables, or multi-agent orchestrator.
Power or host loss; a consumption ref or run directory without a complete receipt is an incomplete infrastructure result.
model.limitation: The dedicated compare-and-swap ref is a durable ordinary-replay barrier in the trusted no-ref-deletion model, not an append-only guarantee against a malicious repository owner.

rules: The reviewed protocol commit P is clean, has one parent equal to expected_parent_commit_sha1, and has the exact recursive raw delta above.
All three added files are regular blobs at mode 100644 and match their bound SHA-256 values.
The inherited container runner and protected source/test are hash-bound but are not parsed, imported, compiled, or executed during static review.

authorization_chain.required_topology: base_package.expected_parent_commit_sha1 -> P -> A; the dedicated consumption ref points to C whose sole parent is A while the branch remains at A
rules: The bootstrap verifies P, A, all raw modes and paths, and all runner/policy hashes before any repository runner byte executes.
The validator accepts exactly three pairwise-distinct fresh GO receipts and one exact decision, all bound to P and the protected bytes.
Before Docker create, the host runner writes C with parent A and atomically creates the absent dedicated ref using update-ref with an all-zero old value.
A pre-existing ref or a losing compare-and-swap rejects the run before protected execution.
The branch and worktree remain at clean A; the protected archive is addressed by exact A, while C records consumption only.

runner_script_lines: git_safe() { /opt/homebrew/bin/gtimeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 30s /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp LANG=C LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 /usr/bin/git -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null -C "$repo" "$@"; }

git_safe show "${a}:${host_path}" | /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp LANG=C LC_ALL=C PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock /bin/zsh -f -s -- launch "$a" "$p" "$protocol_sha" "$host_sha" "$validator_sha" "$container_sha"
canonical_bootstrap.instantiation_rule: Join runner_script_lines with LF and one terminal LF. Replace each template token exactly once with its lowercase hexadecimal value committed in A. Reject any remaining token, extra substitution, prefix, suffix, alternate environment, cwd, or argv.
canonical_bootstrap.trust_order: Only absolute-path bootstrap tools run before the host blob hash is verified. Every Git call uses the bounded config-neutralized wrapper. The verified host blob is then streamed from exact A to a clean zsh process.

rules: Before authorization, complete sidecar/cache inventories and the ancestor-sidecar list are empty.
Every inventory find is individually time-bounded, its status is checked, and unreadable or ambiguous output is infrastructure failure.
Inventories are repeated before execution, after cleanup, and during finalization.
The run-directory sibling sidecar remains absent.

host_runner.atomic_claim: Direct mkdir without -p claims the run path only after immutable preclaim checks.
host_runner.durable_consumption: Before Docker create, plumbing writes a one-file tree and C with sole parent A, then compare-and-swap update-ref creates the dedicated ref only from the all-zero old value.
host_runner.one_shot_rule: An existing run directory or consumption ref rejects replay. Missing complete receipt after either claim is an INCOMPLETE_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE. Ordinary replay cannot recreate the ref without forbidden deletion or rewriting.

wall_limits.rule: No Git or Docker operation is unbounded. The 180-second controller covers archive, input capture, container attach, protected execution, and their stdout/stderr.

host_output_limit.scope: RLIMIT_FSIZE applies to Git archive, tee, Docker attach, stdout, stderr, timeout diagnostics, and resource accounting. Bounded trusted setup receipts are outside it.

resource_accounting.host: time -lp covers the complete protected archive/tee/Docker-attach pipeline.
resource_accounting.container: Canonical JSON records integral before/after cgroup CPU, memory current/peak, and pids current/peak counters.
resource_accounting.fixed_overhead: Preclaim, authorization validation, Git consumption, Docker create/inspect/cleanup, and receipt finalization are retained as wall-bounded development overhead but are not charged to the protected pipeline time.
resource_accounting.limitation: This is development-test accounting only, not relation-generation or ECDLP cost evidence.

input_transport.method: git archive at exact A, piped through tee to exact-ID Docker stdin
input_transport.rule: The digest-bound image extracts into capped /tmp, verifies the container-runner SHA-256 before Python starts, and the runner verifies source/test hashes before import.

authorized_writes: transient exact-ref lock files under the same refs/logs directories
forbidden_writes: the worktree contents outside the run directory

host_runner.artifact_rule: All run artifacts remain in the unique run directory. Final sidecar/cache inventories, complete run receipt, exact Git-consumption paths, Docker inspect/cleanup evidence, and a SHA-256 manifest are mandatory before terminal classification.

receipt_format.type: UTF-8 LF-terminated key=value lines plus artifact-manifest.sha256
receipt_format.terminal_rule: Every normal terminal path after run-directory claim writes classification and a complete receipt. A claimed path or ref without a complete receipt is classified post hoc as incomplete infrastructure.

container.creation: docker create returns an unnamed 64-hex container ID; every later inspect, start, and removal operation uses that exact returned ID.
container.ownership: The exact create-returned ID is the primary ownership token. Matching authorization and consumption labels are additionally required whenever inspect succeeds. Cleanup still removes the exact returned ID if a rejection makes inspect unavailable.
container.cleanup_rule: Before final receipt, exact-ID absence must be proved by a nonzero inspect with the exact No-such-object diagnostic. A valid result additionally requires a successful exact-ID rm after valid post-run inspect.

canonical_test_result.validator_rule: Require an exact three-line pipeline status of 0,0,0; exactly one LF-terminated canonical jq -cS JSON value; exact keys, events, integral bounded counters, empty details/stderr, exit-state agreement, OOM false, proved cleanup, final empty inventories, and artifact manifest.
canonical_test_result.interpretation: A valid result is development evidence for the exact public-core behavior only. It is not an experiment run, relation, curve-family result, scaling estimate, rho comparison, or ECDLP improvement.

rules: Each GO receipt has exact keys and exact role ID/path.
Every reviewer ID is a nonzero UUID string, outside the 44 exclusions, and pairwise distinct.
Principal authenticity is externally trusted and is not inferred from UUID syntax.
Every observed topology, tree, raw delta, mode, digest, image, and inventory fact is exact.
Any defect produces REVISE and no GO JSON.

authorization_decision_schema.required_interpretation: One isolated public development-test run only; no registered seed, campaign, experiment, scaling, rho, or ECDLP-improvement authority.
rules: The coordinator writes the decision only after three exact GO receipts.
Receipt hashes and role-to-principal maps equal the committed blobs exactly.
All identities and digests equal P and the protected source/test.
The decision grants exactly one development run and no cryptanalytic experiment authority.

theory: Does the stream-extracted runner load exactly the five bound tests and no alternate input?
Are Python startup, import origin, cgroup/mount preflight, and development-only interpretation exact?
Does the V4 change preserve source/test contracts without executing protected bytes?
accounting: Does the dedicated compare-and-swap ref consume authorization before protected execution and resist ordinary replay?
Are actual linked-worktree writes, per-operation bounds, pipeline charging, Docker HostConfig, integral cgroup use, OOM, exact-ID cleanup, final inventories, and manifest complete?
Can every terminal and incomplete outcome be distinguished under the stated trusted-local model?
red_team: Can any unverified repository runner byte execute, any local fsmonitor/hook/config path run pre-trust, or any schema/type/principal substitution false-pass?
Can a replay, raw-mode substitution, failed find, inspect rejection, cleanup failure, pipeline-status omission, extra JSON, fractional counter, cache, sidecar, or output flood false-pass?
Are all remaining concurrency, daemon, receipt-authenticity, history-rewrite, and fixed-overhead assumptions explicit and narrow?

go_no_go.go: Three fresh exact GO receipts, validated four-file A directly on P, exact bootstrap instantiation, clean inventories, absent run/ref, pinned tools/image, and no replacement or graft state.
go_no_go.no_go: Any REVISE, mismatch, token residue, inventory/cache, tool/image drift, existing run/ref, dirty tree, replacement/graft, or incomplete cleanup leaves execution unauthorized.
go_no_go.next_action_after_go: Invoke the exact instantiated bootstrap once. Preserve the dedicated consumption ref and complete run directory, then obtain independent result interpretation before any experiment design.
